The moment arrived when they were needed; … They sent … there, … Which takes precedence, … Sinai or one who uproots mountains?

The moment arrived when they were needed; one of them was to be chosen as head of the yeshiva. They sent the following question there, to the Sages of Eretz Yisrael: Which takes precedence, Sinai or one who uproots mountains?
